item.title: I built a tool to deploy small AI apps. Am I solving a real problem?
item.summary: I built a tool that deploys small AI apps from GitHub without needing AWS or keeping your laptop running. Before I spend more time on it, I'm curious—how are you all deploying apps that only a few people use? Is this a real pain point for you?
